title: Patch: the combat forecast projects an attack past what its own other hits kill

**Issue #4379 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4379: Patch: the combat forecast projects an attack past what its own other hits kill
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When you aim an attack, the game tells you beforehand what the attack will do: how much it deals, whether it kills, what splashes onto the neighbours and what spills over onto the hero. Today that preview reads the board exactly as it stands. That goes wrong in one corner: when an attack strikes several units at once and those side hits kill the very units whose presence keeps the target standing. A sweeping blow can kill the two neighbours whose shared protection holds the target up, so by the time the main blow lands the target is weaker than the preview promised. After this change the preview first takes off what the attack's own hits are sure to destroy, and only then says what happens to the rest, so the numbers players see in the trickiest fights are the numbers the fight deals.

## Why

- The fuzz oracle I18 holds every plain attack to its forecast, but R4318000 carved out exactly this corner after fuzz seed 6180, where a sweep killed the two units whose auras held its target up. Two bullets of the skip predicate now excuse every attack whose other hits strike a unit with a card beneath or held by it, and every attack where counting every unit it strikes as dying lowers the other combatant. Each new sweeping or aura-sharing card widens that blind spot.
- The forecast is not trivia: the aimed-attack preview marks splashed units and overflow heroes from it (R4290000), the tutorial coach names its attacks by it, and the lethal sum reads off it. A forecast that ignores the attack's own kills misleads all three at once.
- Nothing open or rejected covers this: the forecast work (#4307, #4257, #4318) shipped the fields and the carve-out, and #4338's rejected AI valuation is a different consumer. Restoring the oracle is new work.

## Proposal

- Teach the one-attack projection to settle the attack's own other hits first: on a scratch copy, remove the units beside the main combatants that the projected blow, Cleave splash and sweep hits destroy, recompute the layered board, then project the main blow, the splash dealt and kills, the Trample overflow and the lethal sum from that board.
- Keep the skip for deaths the board cannot foretell (cards dormant beneath or held, would-die replacements, hooks, traps, chains and reflections); narrow only the two R4318000 bullets to what the projection still cannot see.
- Add the ruling note in the new issue's number block with its section-11 paragraph, and engine tests in the forecast's shape: a sweep that kills its target's aura-bearers (the seed-6180 shape) and a Cleave whose neighbour's death lowers its target, both judged by I18 again.

## Where it lands

- `crates/engine/src/query.rs`: the one-attack projection behind `combat_forecast` (SPEC sections 4.2 to 4.5: combat, the damage pipeline and the state check).
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`: the skip predicate and I18's wiring.
- `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs` (plus a fixture as needed): the new proving tests.
- `spec/rulings/R<nnnn>.md` in the new issue's block, its section-11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, amending the R4318000 paragraph. The client needs no change: it already renders what the forecast says.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A new ruling note exists in the suggestion issue's block, its `proven_in` naming the new tests, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] On a seed-6180-shaped board the forecast's splash, dealt, kills and overflow match what the combat deals, and the lethal sum agrees.
- [ ] I18 judges sweep-kills-aura-bearer and Cleave-neighbour-death attacks again instead of skipping them; the remaining skips are only hooks, traps, chains, reflections, replacements and hidden cards.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit` and the cards suite pass, and a fuzz run over the previously failing seeds stays green.

## Size and risks

- Engine-rules work: label `difficulty:hard`. One query function, one monitor predicate, tests and one ruling note; no card scripts change.
- Main risk is projection cost per listed attack; bound it by reusing the units the attack already enumerates (its Cleave neighbours and sweep hits) on a scratch copy. Rejected: simulating the attack with `reduce`, which R4290000 already ruled out as too heavy and prompt-reaching.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44866373680)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`combat_forecast` should say what an attack's own state check does. It will settle the deaths of the attack's other hits on a scratch copy of the board. That covers the Cleave neighbours, the sweep hits and the strike back. Each death that lowers another unit (an aura-bearer dying) then counts. As a result, `kills`, `survives` and each splash `kills` match the combat on the seed-6180 shape (a sweep or Cleave kills the units whose aura holds the target up). I18 then judges those attacks again.

I18's remaining skips are a card beneath or held, a Reborn unit that goes before a later pass, and the unchanged hooks, traps, chains, reflections and replacements. The change also needs a new ruling with `proven_in` tests, and `cargo jackioh spec check` must pass.

**Decision the issue left open (this departs from its wording).** The issue says to re-project the main blow, splash `dealt`, overflow and lethal sum from the settled board. I would not do that.

- Deaths happen in `state_check` passes *after* the whole combat (§4.5, R59), so every hit lands on the standing board.
- A Trample 3 into a 4-health target held up by a dying neighbour deals 3 with no overflow. Re-projecting from the settled board would say 2 dealt and 1 overflow.
- So `dealt`, `taken`, `pops`, splash `dealt`, overflow and the lethal sum stay as they are.
- Only `kills`, `survives` and splash `kills` change, and only from false to true (`kills`) or true to false (`survives`).
- The lethal sum needs no code change, because hero damage is dealt before any death. A test proves it agrees.

## Steps

1. **`state_check.rs`.** Make `fn units_of` (line 38) and `fn is_dying` (line 64) `pub(crate)`. This lets the forecast reuse the real pass's own reading.

2. **`query.rs`, new types** (near `AttackForecast`):
   ```rust
   #[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub struct AttackDeaths { pub passes: Vec<Vec<String>> }
   impl AttackDeaths {
       pub fn gone(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &String> { self.passes.iter().flatten() }
       pub fn goes(&self, id: &str) -> bool { self.gone().any(|gone| gone == id) }
   }
   struct Reached { unit: CardInstance, dealt: i32, destroyed: bool }
   ```
   `AttackDeaths` has no serde or ts derive. Doc it as R4379000: the ids each pass of §4.5's check removes, as the board stood before the attack. Pass 1 is the units the attack's own hits destroy. A later pass is the units the passes before it left too weak.

3. **`query.rs`, `layers_read_the_board(state) -> bool`.** This is true when `crate::layers::aura_sources(state)` has a source where `!source.vanilla` and `script_of(state, source)` has `aura.is_some() || set_stat.is_some()`. Only those layers read other cards (`compute_layers_on` layers 2 and 5).

4. **`query.rs`, `settle_deaths(state, reached: &[Reached]) -> AttackDeaths`:**
   - `first` is the deduped ids of `reached` entries with `destroyed`. If it is empty, return `AttackDeaths::default()`, with no clone.
   - If `!layers_read_the_board(state)`, return `passes: vec![first]`, with no clone.
   - Otherwise `let mut after = state.clone()`. For each `reached`, use `find_instance_mut(&mut after, &id)` to do `damage += dealt`, and set `marked_destroyed = Some(true)` when `destroyed`. The standing verdict wins over `is_dying`, so the result can only add deaths.
   - Then loop. Take `dying` in a block, so the borrow ends: `let auras = AuraTable::new(&after)`, then `PLAYER_IDS.into_iter().flat_map(|p| crate::state_check::units_of(&after, p)).filter(|u| crate::state_check::is_dying(&auras, u)).collect::<Vec<_>>()`.
   - Remove each with `crate::zones::remove_from_field(&mut after, u, Default::default())` and collect the ids that returned true. If none were removed, break; otherwise push them as a pass.
   - The loop ends because every pass removes at least one unit. Add no new constant.
   - Cost guard: the clone carries the whole `applied` log, so these early exits are what bound it.

5. **`query.rs`, `splash_of`.** Return `(Vec<SplashHit>, Vec<StruckUnit>)`. The second is the `swept` list it already computes (`StruckUnit` is `pub(crate)` in `subsystems/lethal.rs`). Update its caller. Keep `kills`, `dealt` and `pops` exactly as they are.

6. **`query.rs`, `forecast_attack`, renamed `project_attack`.** It returns `(AttackForecast, AttackDeaths)`. `combat_forecast` keeps `.0`; the `Reached` lists below are built from values the function already computes. Use `destroys = |dealt| dealt > 0 && (poisons || exiles_on_damage(state, attacker))`.
   - *Unit target, `reached` list:*
     - defender: `dealt`, `destroyed: kills`;
     - attacker: `taken`, `destroyed: !survives` (pre-settle values);
     - each splash neighbour: `dealt: hit.dealt` plus the swept `dealt` on the same unit, `destroyed: hit.kills`;
     - each swept unit that is neither the defender nor a neighbour: `dealt`, `destroyed: destroys(dealt) || (dealt > 0 && dealt >= unit_view(state, &unit).health)`.
     - When `falls`, only the attacker entry exists, because the splash is empty and `dealt` is 0.
   - *Then fold the result in:*
     - `kills |= deaths.goes(&defender.id)`;
     - `survives &= !deaths.goes(&attacker.id)`;
     - each `splash[i].kills |= deaths.goes(&hit.instance_id)`.
   - *Hero target, only when `flags_of(state, attacker).sweep_lane.is_some()`:*
     - Mirror `projected_damage_with`'s hero branch. Use one fresh `ProjectedPools`. Call `crate::damage::project_hit(state, Some(attacker), target, mine.attack, &mut pools)` first, then `swept_units(state, attacker, None, mine.attack, &[], &on_hero, &mut pools)`.
     - Build `reached` from the swept units, with `poisons` being the attacker's Poisonous keyword.
     - Set `survives = !deaths.goes(&attacker.id)`.
     - `kills` (`is_lethal`) and `dealt` are unchanged.

7. **`query.rs`, `pub fn attack_deaths(state, attacker: &CardInstance, target: &AttackTarget) -> AttackDeaths`.** It is `project_attack(state, attacker, target).1`. It is re-exported by `pub use query::*`. Update the `AttackForecast` and `combat_forecast` docs: `kills`, `survives` and splash `kills` count the passes of §4.5's check, and the rest is the standing board.

8. **`testkit/invariants.rs`.**
   - In `foreseeable_attack`, delete `let others = …`, the `others.iter().any(brings_in)` check and the `deaths_lower_a_combatant` call.
   - Keep the unconditional R4221002 check `brings_in(attacker) || struck.iter().any(brings_in)`. The issue narrows only R4318000's two conditions.
   - After the replacement check, add:
     ```rust
     let Some(aimed) = crate::combat::attack_target_of(state, target_id) else { return false };
     let deaths = crate::query::attack_deaths(state, attacker, &aimed);
     let gone: Vec<&CardInstance> = deaths.gone().filter_map(|id| find_instance(state, id)).collect();
     if gone.iter().any(|unit| brings_in(unit)) { return false; }
     if deaths.passes.len() > 1
         && gone.iter().any(|unit| crate::layers::unit_has(state, unit, KeywordKind::Reborn)) { return false; }
     ```
   - Replace the last two bullets of the doc comment, citing R4379000:
     - a Unit the state check removes that has a card beneath it or held (R4221002's reason);
     - a Reborn Unit removed before a later pass (R83: its return restores what that pass would find missing).
   - Delete `struck_besides_target` and `deaths_lower_a_combatant`, and remove any import clippy flags as unused.

9. **AI agreement test** (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`).
   - Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai r4171000`.
   - If it is green, change nothing.
   - If it fails on a board where a cascade changed `kills` or `survives`, add the following inside the entry loop, after the hero skip, with a comment citing R4379000 ("the trade reads do not project the check's later passes"):
     ```rust
     let aimed = jackioh_engine::attack_target_of(state, &entry.target_id).expect("a listed target");
     if jackioh_engine::attack_deaths(state, attacker, &aimed).passes.len() > 1 { continue; }
     ```
     Place it after `attacker` is bound, then re-check the judged floors.
   - Do not change `fight` or `kills_and_survives`, which is the AI valuation (#4338 and R4171000) and out of scope.

10. **Tests and fixture.** See Tests.

11. **Ruling `spec/rulings/R4379000.md`.**
    - Front matter: `id: R4379000`; title "The combat forecast settles the deaths of the attack's own hits, and I18 judges them again (issue #4379)"; `cards: "§4.4, §4.5, R69, R83, R3100000, R3554008, R4111000, R4221002, R4290000, R4318000, issue #4379"`; `proven_in` lists `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs` and `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs`.
    - Body, links written `[[R…]]`: the seed-6180 board, the pass loop, that `dealt`, `taken`, `pops`, overflow and lethal stay the standing board's, the narrowed I18 skips, and "Hearthstone semantics: deaths resolve at the state check after the combat."
    - *Rejected:* re-projecting the blow from the settled board (it misstates Trample); simulating with `reduce` (R3100000, R4290000); judging each removal by aura source alone (misses count-based auras).
    - *Not modelled:* the AI's trade reads (R4171000) stay the standing board's.
    - Also append `Amended by [[R4379000]] (issue #4379): …` to `spec/rulings/R4318000.md` and `spec/rulings/R4111000.md`.
    - Create `spec/pending/4379.md` with `**[[R4379000]] … (issue #4379, 2026-11-21):** …`.

12. **`crates/engine/README.md` row 28.** Say that `kills`, `survives` and splash `kills` include the state check's later passes (R4379000), and name `attack_deaths`.

13. Run the checks in Done when. Report `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`'s wall-clock time, because of the clone cost.

## Tests

**Fixture `crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/aura_deaths.rs`:**
- `pub fn register_script(def_id: &str, script: Script)`, copied from `register_i18_script` (`registered_scripts`, `both`, `register_scripts`).
- `pub fn register_sweeper(def_id: &str)`: `StaticFlags { sweep_lane: Some(1), sweep_adjacent: Some(1), ..Default }`.
- `pub fn aura_board(seed, attacker_def, aura_lane) -> (GameState, String, String)`, moved verbatim from `invariants.rs`. It registers the Charger's aura (+2 max health to its side's other Units), puts the attacker in P1 lane 1, Big Body (5/10, 8 damage, so 5/12 with 4 left) in P2 lane 1, and the Charger in P2 `aura_lane`.

**`combat_forecast.rs`, module `r4379000_the_forecast_settles_the_attack_s_own_deaths`.** Use the file's `forecast_played`, which already asserts forecast equals play. Import the fixture.
- `r4379000_a_cleave_that_kills_the_neighbour_holding_its_target_up_kills_the_target`:
  - Cleaver, aura lane 2.
  - Assert `kills` true, `dealt == 3`, `survives` true.
  - Assert the splash on the Charger is `dealt 3` and `kills true`.
  - Assert `attack_deaths(...).passes` is `[[charger], [big body]]`.
  - Control: with aura lane 3 (out of reach), `kills` is false and `passes` is empty.
  - Control: with the Charger buffed to 8 health (`buffs.health = 5`), `kills` is false.
- `r4379000_a_sweep_that_kills_its_target_s_aura_bearers_kills_the_target`:
  - The seed-6180 shape. A `plain` sweeper, `register_sweeper`, aura lane 2.
  - Assert `kills` true, `survives` false (it takes 5), `splash` empty, and `deaths.goes(charger)`.
- `r4379000_a_trample_blow_is_dealt_on_the_standing_board`:
  - Cleave board with Trample granted on the attacker, so `granted_keywords.push(Keyword::Trample)`.
  - Assert `dealt` is still 3 and `overflow` is `None`, while `kills` is true.
- `r4379000_the_hero_hit_and_the_lethal_sum_agree_on_the_settled_board`:
  - The sweeper attacks `hero-p2`. Set the hero's health to 3, then to 4.
  - Assert `forecast_played` for each, and `combat_forecast(..).lethal == act_ok(..).state.result.is_some()`.
  - Assert `attack_deaths` names the Big Body in the pass after the Charger's.
- `r4379000_a_board_with_no_aura_settles_in_one_pass`: copy `r4290000_splash_and_overflow`'s `cleave_board`; assert a single pass and that the forecast equals play.

**`invariants.rs`.** Import `aura_board`, `register_sweeper` and `register_script` from the fixture.
- Replace `r4318000_i18_an_attack_whose_other_hits_can_take_away_a_combatant_s_aura_is_not_judged` with `r4318000_i18_an_attack_whose_other_hit_destroys_a_unit_with_a_card_beneath_is_not_judged`.
  - Board: `i18_board` plus a swept P2 lane-2 unit built as `r4221002_…` builds its pile (`put`, then `new_instance` and `place_on_field(.., json_as(json!({"stack": true})))`).
  - A top `plain` over a Big Body dies to the sweep, so `judged_drift` is `(0, [])`.
  - A top Big Body over a `plain` survives the sweep, so `judged_drift` is `(1, one "I18 forecast drift")`.
  - Keep an `r4318000_` test here, since the note's `proven_in` needs one.
- `r4379000_i18_judges_an_attack_whose_other_hits_take_away_a_combatant_s_aura`:
  - For the cleave and sweep boards, the untampered play gives `i18(...)` empty and `forecast_judged() == 1`.
  - `judged_drift` finds exactly one drift.
  - Keep the out-of-reach control.
- `r4379000_i18_does_not_judge_a_cascade_past_a_reborn_unit`:
  - Cleave board with `Keyword::Reborn` pushed onto the Charger's `granted_keywords`.
  - Assert `judged_drift == (0, [])`.

## Done when

- [ ] `project_attack` settles deaths. The seed-6180 shapes (sweep, Cleave, hero target) forecast what the combat does, and the lethal sum agrees.
- [ ] I18 judges sweep-kills-aura-bearer and Cleave-neighbour-death attacks. Its remaining skips are only those in Goal, and the old R4318000 conditions are gone.
- [ ] R4379000 exists, with `proven_in` naming tests that run; `Amended by` lines are on R4318000 and R4111000; `spec/pending/4379.md` exists. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] No serialized type changed (`git status apps/web/src/wire` is clean).
- [ ] The engine and cards tests and `r4171000` pass. `fuzz --regress` (which holds seed 6180's record) and `fuzz --seeds 200` are green, and the fuzz wall-clock is reported.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` pass. Run `classify` before pushing, as CLAUDE.md says.

## Risks

- **Cost.** The scratch clone carries all of `applied`. It runs only when a hit unit dies in pass 1 and the board has an aura or `set_stat` source. If the fuzz time grows noticeably, report it rather than weaken the guard, because skipping the clone for non-aura boards is already in.
- **Determinism and purity.** The forecast mutates only a local copy. It adds no clock, I/O or hash-ordered collection, and no new constant: the loop is bounded by the unit count.
- **AI agreement (R4171000).** The forecast and the AI's trade reads now differ on cascade boards. R4318000 had rejected projecting the cascade for exactly this reason. Step 9 is the fallback, and the AI is left alone.
- **Reborn.** The simulation cannot see a Reborn return between passes, hence the Reborn skip. Check the Reborn test against what the reducer does, and keep the skip rather than drop it.
- **Not modelled by the settle:** carriers (R446), tributes and `would die` replacements. The replacement and beneath/held skips stay in I18, as before.
- **Stale test.** The old R4318000 test asserts the removed skip and must be replaced, not left failing.

## Open questions

None blocking. For a person: should the AI's static trade reads (`fight`, `kills_and_survives`, R4171000) later project the cascade too? This plan leaves them alone, as the issue scopes them out (#4338).
````

# Plan (sonnet, medium)

## Goal

`combat_forecast` should say what an attack's own state check does. It will settle the deaths of the attack's other hits on a scratch copy of the board. That covers the Cleave neighbours, the sweep hits and the strike back. Each death that lowers another unit (an aura-bearer dying) then counts. As a result, `kills`, `survives` and each splash `kills` match the combat on the seed-6180 shape (a sweep or Cleave kills the units whose aura holds the target up). I18 then judges those attacks again.

**Decision the issue left open (this departs from its wording).** The issue says to re-project the main blow, splash `dealt`, overflow and lethal sum from the settled board. I would not do that.

- Deaths happen in `state_check` passes *after* the whole combat (§4.5, R59), so every hit lands on the standing board.
- A Trample 3 into a 4-health target held up by a dying neighbour deals 3 with no overflow. Re-projecting from the settled board would say 2 dealt and 1 overflow.
